County Sea-Distance

Great Britain has 170 counties across England, Scotland, and Wales (Northern Ireland is excluded — see the Ireland dashboard). Of these, 89 (52.4%) touch the coast directly and 81 are inland.

The most inland county (distance 4) is NA.

Data: [GADM 4.1](https://gadm.org/data.html) + [GISCO 2016](https://ec.europa.eu/eurostat/web/gisco/geodata/statistical-units). Adjacency via [sf](https://r-spatial.github.io/sf/) with 200 m buffer in EPSG:27700; BFS via [igraph](https://r.igraph.org/).
